highlights.title: Hand-offs keep going without you
highlights.text: A lead hands work on as often as it needs. Exact repeats and a teammate that failed 3 times in a row are skipped with the reason. You press Continue only after 64 hand-offs for one message.

highlights.title: Hand-off cards catch up
highlights.text: After the app loses its connection, cards that said Waiting update on their own when it comes back.

fixes: TikTok's QR sign-in no longer freezes the bot's browser.
